semanticChecks.meaning: Exact lazy import/export joins the shared home parent to oa, without claiming an executed mount.
Ambient slot is guarded outside chat composer mode; absent controller produces no pFt element.
Home element receives explicit host/root/route/plan and generated-enable inputs through the same local slot chain.
Surface is derived from the already-qualified detail-level store, not established as the global product-mode store.
Generated admission combines caller enablement, runtime status, and a non-null project root.
Eligibility lookup is conditional on no debug override and two explicit admission booleans; inventory true is required for experiment eligibility.
Loading/readiness, direct debug override and experiment personalization remain separate source-selection paths.
The two eligibility helpers preserve curated bypass, generated-read settlement and loading suppression.
Generated plugin mentions have availability/install gates; enabled data reaches at most Nr presented results.
Curated categories and writing starter are conditional on the derived Work presentation; free-plan starter rejection is explicit.
Fill accepts before prefill; plugin onboarding accepts generated items in its success callback; start requires a root.
Codex Home AbortError is silent and selected active ID is cleared in the handler finally; service completion is not inferred.
Direct starter creation carries policy snapshot checks, source/trigger attribution and awaited created callback; downstream creation remains a reused provider boundary.
Refresh is a separate mutation with success invalidation and source-defined visibility; no cancellation or durability claim.
All four concrete home policy/query imports resolve to exact eligibility export bindings.
Existing detail-level producer evidence is reused with exact hashes; it is not reopened or promoted to runtime mode proof.

developmentQualification: First verifier draft incorrectly required every AST node sharing an exact span to have one node type; a bare VariableDeclarator and its Identifier legally share the span. Corrected to require existence of the selected exact span/type pair. Initial draft preserved; no target parser failure.
retainedBoundaries: Actual UI mount/effective controller and host/root/account/feature/experiment values remain unobserved.
Existing Tq/cjn/sjn detail-level provider, eligibility inventory/TOS, plugin install, task creation, navigation, status and persistence interfaces are reused; no recursive expansion.
Source-driven observation conditions are unexecuted. No remaining model authorization is created by this contract.
Canonical home operation adoption, whole-feature mode closure and full independent runtime/build acceptance remain incomplete.
